attempted_claim: Let H be the extended affine Hecke algebra of type G~2 over A=C[v,v^-1] with equal parameters L(s1)=L(s2)=L(s3) (ratio r=a/b=1). Is H affine cellular in the sense of Koenig-Xi with cell ideals filtered by the non-generic Kazhdan-Lusztig two-sided cell order, with explicit finite-rank V_j, affine A-algebras B_j and bilinear forms phi_j; and upon specialization v|->zeta with zeta^2 a root of unity of small order (in particular zeta^2=+/-1), does the specialized datum parametrize simple H_zeta-modules as {(j,m): some (phi_j)_st not in m} with unitriangular decomposition matrix coinciding with Davis's principal-series composition factors for type G2?
decisive_failure: The investigation was limited to literature-verified routes within a one-hour pass: full-text analysis of Guilhot-Miemietz 1011.2010, Guilhot 0901.1711, and Davis 1104.4826; computational verification was restricted to Lusztig a-value arithmetic and table cross-checks; no CHEVIE/GAP Kazhdan-Lusztig recomputation at r=1 was available, so neither a positive cellular datum nor a rigorous impossibility proof at equal parameters could be established.
